clips.title: The story
paras: Marek Ironheart is a veteran dwarven hunter stationed at the Farstrider Lodge in south-eastern Loch Modan. Dedicated to the traditions of the wild, he tests wandering travelers and marksmen alike before welcoming them into the ranks of the lodge's honored hunters.

Perched on the scenic ridge overlooking the lake, the Farstrider Lodge serves as an outpost for the finest marksmen and trackers in the dwarven lands. Marek Ironheart embodies this frontier spirit. Unimpressed by titles or talk, Marek requires anyone seeking the lodge's respect to demonstrate their practical prowess against the varied beasts roaming Loch Modan, proving they have the patience and nerve demanded of a true stalker of the wild.
